name: Maani Ghaffari
title: Associate Professor
department: Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering; Robotics
fitReason: Strong current physical-autonomy fit: learned long-horizon navigation and world-model-based contact planning complement perception and uncertainty-aware control.

physicalEvidence.summary: LongNav-R1 (RSS2026; manuscript revised September8,2026) deploys a multi-turn RL-trained VLA on a real mobile base built from the TidyBot++ design, without a manipulator, to find an unseen elevator. Current CURLY postdoc Yue Hu is lead author and the implementation is maintained under UMich-CURLY. Ego-VCP (ICRA2026) additionally demonstrates learned-world-model/MPC contact planning on a physical humanoid. These establish lab-linked and collaborative hardware research, without proving exclusive hardware ownership or guaranteed visitor access.

shortVisit.summary: The past-members roster includes an external master's visiting student from Eindhoven and several visiting PhD students. No current external master's, internship or visiting-student invitation was verified in the checked lab homepage, People, Research and Contact pages; historical precedent earns no opportunity credit.
